First, convert 48 weeks and 5 days to days:  
48 weeks × 7 days/week = 336 days  
336 + 5 = 341 days to subtract.

Date given: 1183-09-05 (assuming format is DD-MM-YYYY, so 05-09-1183 → 1183-09-05).  
Subtract 341 days from 1183-09-05.

1183 is not a leap year (leap years divisible by 4, but 1183 not divisible by 4).  
From 1183-09-05 back 341 days:  
Go back 5 days to 1183-08-31.  
Remaining: 341 − 5 = 336 days earlier.

From 1183-08-31, go back 31 days of August to 1183-07-31. Remaining: 336 − 31 = 305 days.  
July has 31 days, so from 1183-07-31 back 31 days to 1183-06-30. Remaining: 305 − 31 = 274 days.  
June has 30 days, back to 1183-05-31. Remaining: 274 − 30 = 244 days.  
May has 31 days, back to 1183-04-30. Remaining: 244 − 31 = 213 days.  
April has 30 days, back to 1183-03-31. Remaining: 213 − 30 = 183 days.  
March has 31 days, back to 1183-02-28 (not leap year). Remaining: 183 − 31 = 152 days.  
February has 28 days, back to 1183-01-31. Remaining: 152 − 28 = 124 days.  
January has 31 days, back to 1182-12-31. Remaining: 124 − 31 = 93 days.
